player_signals.summary: With Davis out and expected to miss extended time, Demercado is the current Cowboys RB2 behind Javonte Williams. Hunter Luepke and practice-squad Israel Abanikanda are the other named options. Dallas may still add another back.

player_signals.summary: In the Melbourne Week 1 win, Black out-carried Christian McCaffrey 14-10 for 65 yards plus 1-5 receiving. Snap split was roughly CMC 35-36 / Black 28. Jordan James was a healthy inactive, confirming Black as SF RB2. CMC kept third-down and most red-zone priority.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Black is already OWNED on the Mongo bench. Usage upgraded him from pure handcuff to RB2 with occasional standalone early-down work. Not a drop.

player_signals.summary: Saints final Week 1 report: Audric Estime (thigh) OUT, Alvin Kamara (knee) QUESTIONABLE after a full Friday practice. Beat reporter Nick Underhill says Kamara will not have a huge role if active because New Orleans is deep at RB; Travis Etienne should lead, with Miller next.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Miller is OWNED on the bench. He is the clearest change-of-pace/RB3 with a path to extra Week 1 work if Kamara is limited or inactive. Still not a start over Achane/Bijan.
